fields.label: Installment No
fields.description: Unique installment identifier within the contract.

fields.label: Label
fields.description: Short description for this installment, such as Down Payment or 2nd Installment.

fields.label: Installment Type
fields.options:
Booking
Down Payment
Contract
Construction Milestone
Handover
Post Handover
Other
fields.description: Classifies the installment by stage in the sales or construction process.

fields.label: Due Date
fields.description: Date on which this installment becomes due for payment.

fields.label: Percent
fields.description: Percentage of the net contract price represented by this installment.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Due
Partial
Paid
Overdue
Waived
Cancelled
fields.description: Current payment status of this installment.

fields.label: Invoice
fields.description: Sales Invoice linked to this installment. Created in a later phase.

fields.label: Payment
fields.description: Payment Entry linked to this installment. Created in a later phase.

fields.label: Payment Reference
fields.description: External payment reference or receipt number for this installment.

fields.label: Payment Method
fields.options:
Cash
Bank Transfer
Cheque
Credit Card
Other
fields.description: Expected or recorded payment method for this installment.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Additional notes or instructions for this installment.

name: Sales Installment Schedule
description: Child table storing installment schedule rows for a Sales Contract. Each row represents a scheduled payment linked to a real estate unit sale.
